Hi!🤍 My name is Irina, I’m a travel & beauty content creator with 600K+ followers across Instagram and TikTok.

I’m planning a trip to Dubai in mid-to-late October and I’m currently looking for a beautiful beachfront property for a 10–14 night stay. I came across your apartments at Sarai on Palm Jumeirah and absolutely loved the location and the property!

I’d love to explore a potential collaboration. I can create high-quality Reels/TikToks, Stories and photo content showcasing the property and the experience during my stay.

My dates are flexible between mid and late October, as I haven’t booked my flights yet, so I can adjust the dates depending on your availability.

I’d be happy to discuss the details and create content that you can also use for your social media/marketing🪄🫶🏽

Here are my social media links: 
https://www.tiktok.com/@irina_divine?_t=ZM-8sIO6hh2eJB&_r=1

https://www.instagram.com/irinadeikalo?igsh=bnozYTdmOTVpcHMy

I’d love to hear from you! 🤍
